author: Rubiuz
quote: Despite its impressive visuals, Grand Theft Auto VI has disappointed many fans who feel it prioritizes hyper-realism over the classic, fast-paced fun the series is known **** main criticisms boil down to four issues:Slow, Tedious Gameplay: Like Red Dead Redemption 2, the game bogs down simple actions with lengthy animations and heavy, sluggish controls, making it feel more like a chore simulator than an arcade sandbox.30 FPS Limit: Locking current-gen consoles to 30 frames per second—with noticeable frame drops during intense action—feels outdated for a flagship release.Loss of Classic Satire: Without longtime writer Dan Houser, the sharp, cynical humor has been replaced by a grounded, overly serious romantic drama that restricts the chaotic freedom players expect.Greedy Monetization: Locking single-player content behind expensive special editions and delaying the PC release has frustrated the fanbase.Ultimately, in trying to build the most realistic crime drama possible, Rockstar lost the irreverent, chaotic soul that made GTA fun in the first place.
